text:
Maya Patel: FYI — saw a small but consistent QA regression on quantized v2 (int4) vs fp16 on the 'short-answer' promptset. Err rate up ~4% on golden. Rolling a quick triage, tagging @Omar @Jin. Can ppl check if it's dataset noise or model drift? :eyes:

Omar Singh: Which eval/metric? where did you see the 4%? link?

Maya Patel: run: `evals/bench/short_answer/2026-03-18/quant-vs-fp16.csv` — summary: precision drop from 92.1 -> 88.0 on golden subset. Fails look like hallucinated adds and trimmed endings.

Jin Park: Hmm ok. Are these examples overlapping with newly ingested synthetic set? last ingest was 03/14.

Ash Cohen: Could be dedupe leakage. If dedupe missed near-duplicates we reweighted, that can skew short-answer distribution. I'll run a quick fingerprint scan on the golden set.

Zeeshan Raza: Also check tokenizer truncation differences with quant runtime — some tokenization rounding affects kv-cache offsets. cc eng-runtime.

Maya Patel: Action items: 1) Jin run dedupe fingerprint on golden vs recent ingest, 2) Ash run tokenizer/truncation diff on failing cases, 3) Omar rerun quant eval with beam=1 and beam=3 to check decoding sensitivity. Leave comments on thread. Target: decide whether to quarantine this golden slice by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Omar Singh: started reruns (cmd snippet):
```
python tools/eval.py --suite short_answer --model quant-v2 --beams 1,3 --out /tmp/quant-runs
```
ETA 35m

labeler-bot: queued 42 examples into `ops/quick-relabel` for manual review (priority: high). Labels required: accept/reject + short notes.

Ash Cohen: fingerprint scan done — 6 near-duplicates between golden and syntheticholdout, likely introduced 03/14 ingest. tagging @Maya; pulling those out to a quarantine slice now.

Jin Park: tokenizer diff: failing examples often end with emoji or URLs — quant path strips trailing whitespace differently leading to partial answers. Filed runtime issue #4123. Workaround: trim-normalize inputs before encode. I'll push a small preproc patch to dev and test.

Maya Patel: nice. If preproc fixes most regressions we can avoid immediate golden edit. If not, we'll require relabel + golden update. Keep decisions here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Omar Singh: reruns done. beam=1 precision 87.9, beam=3 88.1. No major decoding sensitivity. Suggests model/tokenizer-caused output.

Zeeshan Raza: noted runtime issue. Eng-runtime to investigate on Monday. For now, Jin's preproc patch to dev + small eval on a holdout should be quick.

Maya Patel: Plan: Jin lands preproc patch to dev, Omar reruns dev quant eval on the quarantine slice, labelers finish reviews for 42 examples. If dev eval improves >=2% on quarantine, we won't change golden. Otherwise, prepare golden relabel + backfill. I'll update product and ops.

Ash Cohen: copying summary to #product-qa and will file a short postmortem if golden needs edit.

Maya Patel: closing loop: will ping again once dev run completes. Thanks.
